passages.text: Now Sarah lived to be 127 years old.
passages.sermon: Sarah was Abraham’s wife.\r\nSarah lived for 127 years.\r\nThis was the length of Sarah’s life.
passages.original: וַיִּהְיוּ֙ חַיֵּ֣י שָׂרָ֔ה מֵאָ֥ה שָׁנָ֛ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְשֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֖י חַיֵּ֥י שָׂרָֽה׃

passages.text: She died in Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham went out to mourn and to weep for her.
passages.sermon:
Sarah was Abraham’s wife.
Sarah died in Kiriath-arba.
Kiriath-arba is also called Hebron.
Hebron is in the land of Canaan.
Abraham went to mourn for Sarah.
Abraham wept for her.
passages.original: וַתָּ֣מָת שָׂרָ֗ה בְּקִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע הִ֥וא חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיָּבֹא֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם לִסְפֹּ֥ד לְשָׂרָ֖ה וְלִבְכֹּתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Then Abraham got up from beside his dead wife and said to the Hittites, “I am a foreigner and an outsider among you. Give me a burial site among you so that I can bury my dead.”
passages.sermon:
Abraham was a foreigner and an outsider living among the Hittites.
Sarah, Abraham’s wife, had died.
Abraham sat beside his dead wife.
Abraham got up from beside his dead wife.
Abraham spoke to the Hittites.
Abraham said, “I am a foreigner and an outsider among you.”
Abraham said, “Give me a burial site among you.”
Abraham said, “I want to bury my dead.”
passages.original: וַיָּ֙קָם֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י מֵת֑וֹ וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ בְּנֵי־ חֵ֖ת לֵאמֹֽר׃ גֵּר־ וְתוֹשָׁ֥ב אָנֹכִ֖י עִמָּכֶ֑ם תְּנ֨וּ לִ֤י אֲחֻזַּת־ קֶ֙בֶר֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְאֶקְבְּרָ֥ה מֵתִ֖י מִלְּפָנָֽי׃

passages.text: The Hittites replied to Abraham, “Listen to us, sir. You are God’s chosen one among us. Bury your dead in the finest of our tombs. None of us will withhold his tomb for burying your dead.”
passages.sermon:
The Hittites spoke to Abraham.
They answered him.
They said, “Listen to us, sir.
You are a prince of God among us.
You may bury your dead in the best of our tombs.
No one among us will refuse you his tomb for burying your dead.”
passages.original: וַיַּעֲנ֧וּ בְנֵי־ חֵ֛ת אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֥ר לֽוֹ׃ שְׁמָעֵ֣נוּ׀ אֲדֹנִ֗י נְשִׂ֨יא אֱלֹהִ֤ים אַתָּה֙ בְּתוֹכֵ֔נוּ בְּמִבְחַ֣ר קְבָרֵ֔ינוּ קְבֹ֖ר אֶת־ מֵתֶ֑ךָ אִ֣ישׁ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ אֶת־ קִבְר֛וֹ לֹֽא־ יִכְלֶ֥ה מִמְּךָ֖ מִקְּבֹ֥ר מֵתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Then Abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the Hittites.
passages.sermon:
Abraham was a foreigner living among the Hittites.
Abraham stood up.
He bowed down.
He bowed before the people of the land.
He bowed before the Hittites.
passages.original: וַיָּ֧קָם אַבְרָהָ֛ם וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ לְעַם־ הָאָ֖רֶץ לִבְנֵי־ חֵֽת׃

passages.text: “If you are willing for me to bury my dead,” he said to them, “listen to me, and approach Ephron son of Zohar on my behalf to sell me the cave of Machpelah that belongs to him; it is at the end of his field. Let him sell it to me in your presence for full price, so that I may have a burial site.”
passages.sermon:
Abraham spoke to the Hittites.
He said, "If you are willing for me to bury my dead, listen to me."
"Go to Ephron son of Zohar for me."
"Ask him to give me the cave of Machpelah."
"This cave belongs to him."
"It is at the end of his field."
"Let him sell it to me for its full price."
"Let him do this while you are present."
"Then I will have a burial site among you."
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתָּ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר אִם־ יֵ֣שׁ אֶֽת־ נַפְשְׁכֶ֗ם לִקְבֹּ֤ר אֶת־ מֵתִי֙ מִלְּפָנַ֔י שְׁמָע֕וּנִי וּפִגְעוּ־ לִ֖י בְּעֶפְר֥וֹן בֶּן־ צֹֽחַר׃ וְיִתֶּן־ לִ֗י אֶת־ מְעָרַ֤ת הַמַּכְפֵּלָה֙ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּקְצֵ֣ה שָׂדֵ֑הוּ בְּכֶ֨סֶף מָלֵ֜א יִתְּנֶ֥נָּה לִ֛י בְּתוֹכְכֶ֖ם לַאֲחֻזַּת־ קָֽבֶר׃

passages.text: Now Ephron was sitting among the sons of Heth. So in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city, Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham, “No, my lord. Listen to me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. I give it to you in the presence of my people. Bury your dead.”
passages.sermon:
Ephron was a Hittite.
He was sitting among the sons of Heth.
Many Hittites had come to the gate of his city.
Ephron answered Abraham in front of them all.
He said, “No, my lord.
Listen to me.
I give you the field.
I also give you the cave that is in the field.
I give it to you in the presence of my people.
Bury your dead.”
passages.original: וְעֶפְר֥וֹן יֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּת֣וֹךְ בְּנֵי־ חֵ֑ת וַיַּעַן֩ עֶפְר֨וֹן הַחִתִּ֤י אֶת־ אַבְרָהָם֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י בְנֵי־ חֵ֔ת לְכֹ֛ל בָּאֵ֥י שַֽׁעַר־ עִיר֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃ לֹֽא־ אֲדֹנִ֣י שְׁמָעֵ֔נִי הַשָּׂדֶה֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔ךְ וְהַמְּעָרָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֖וֹ לְךָ֣ נְתַתִּ֑יהָ לְעֵינֵ֧י בְנֵי־ עַמִּ֛י נְתַתִּ֥יהָ לָּ֖ךְ קְבֹ֥ר מֵתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Again Abraham bowed down before the people of the land and said to Ephron in their presence, “If you will please listen to me, I will pay you the price of the field. Accept it from me, so that I may bury my dead there.”
passages.sermon:
Abraham was a foreigner living among the Hittites.
He wanted to buy a burial place for his wife Sarah.
Abraham bowed down before the people of the land.
He showed respect to the Hittites.
Abraham spoke to Ephron.
He spoke in the hearing of all the people.
Abraham said, “Please listen to me.
I will give you the price of the field.
Take the money from me.
Then I will bury my dead there.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁתַּ֙חוּ֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י עַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃ וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֶל־ עֶפְר֜וֹן בְּאָזְנֵ֤י עַם־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַ֛ךְ אִם־ אַתָּ֥ה ל֖וּ שְׁמָעֵ֑נִי נָתַ֜תִּי כֶּ֤סֶף הַשָּׂדֶה֙ קַ֣ח מִמֶּ֔נִּי וְאֶקְבְּרָ֥ה אֶת־ מֵתִ֖י שָֽׁמָּה׃

passages.text: Ephron answered Abraham, “Listen to me, my lord. The land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between you and me? Bury your dead.”
passages.sermon:
Ephron was a Hittite.  
Ephron spoke to Abraham.  
Ephron said, "Listen to me, my lord."  
Ephron said, "The land is worth four hundred shekels of silver."  
Ephron said, "That amount is nothing between you and me."  
Ephron said, "Bury your dead."
passages.original: וַיַּ֧עַן עֶפְר֛וֹן אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֥ר לֽוֹ׃ אֲדֹנִ֣י שְׁמָעֵ֔נִי אֶרֶץ֩ אַרְבַּ֨ע מֵאֹ֧ת שֶֽׁקֶל־ כֶּ֛סֶף בֵּינִ֥י וּבֵֽינְךָ֖ מַה־ הִ֑וא וְאֶת־ מֵתְךָ֖ קְבֹֽר׃

passages.text: Abraham agreed to Ephron’s terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the standard of the merchants.
passages.sermon:
Abraham was a foreigner living among the Hittites.
Ephron was a man from the Hittite people.
Ephron offered to sell his field to Abraham.
Abraham listened to Ephron.
Abraham accepted Ephron’s terms.
Abraham took silver.
Abraham weighed out the silver for Ephron.
Abraham gave Ephron four hundred shekels of silver.
The Hittites heard the agreement.
Abraham used the standard weight for merchants.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע אַבְרָהָם֮ אֶל־ עֶפְרוֹן֒ וַיִּשְׁקֹ֤ל אַבְרָהָם֙ לְעֶפְרֹ֔ן אֶת־ הַכֶּ֕סֶף אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר בְּאָזְנֵ֣י בְנֵי־ חֵ֑ת אַרְבַּ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ שֶׁ֣קֶל כֶּ֔סֶף עֹבֵ֖ר לַסֹּחֵֽר׃

passages.text: So Ephron’s field at Machpelah near Mamre, the cave that was in it, and all the trees within the boundaries of the field were deeded over to Abraham’s possession in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city.
passages.sermon:
Ephron owned a field at Machpelah near Mamre.
The field included a cave.
Many trees stood in the field.
All the trees were inside the field’s boundaries.
Ephron’s field, the cave, and all the trees became Abraham’s property.
The Hittites witnessed this transaction.
The Hittites were present at the city gate.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣קָם׀ שְׂדֵ֣ה עֶפְר֗וֹן אֲשֶׁר֙ בַּמַּכְפֵּלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י מַמְרֵ֑א הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְהַמְּעָרָ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֔וֹ וְכָל־ הָעֵץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּכָל־ גְּבֻל֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְמִקְנָ֖ה לְעֵינֵ֣י בְנֵי־ חֵ֑ת בְּכֹ֖ל בָּאֵ֥י שַֽׁעַר־ עִירֽוֹ׃

passages.text: After this, Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave of the field at Machpelah near Mamre (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan.
passages.sermon:
Abraham was a man whom God had blessed in every way.
Abraham was old and lived in the land of Canaan.
Sarah was Abraham’s wife.
Sarah died.
After this, Abraham buried Sarah.
He buried her in the cave of the field at Machpelah.
Machpelah was near Mamre.
Mamre is also called Hebron.
Hebron is in the land of Canaan.
passages.original: וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵן֩ קָבַ֨ר אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת־ שָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ אֶל־ מְעָרַ֞ת שְׂדֵ֧ה הַמַּכְפֵּלָ֛ה עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י מַמְרֵ֖א הִ֣וא חֶבְר֑וֹן בְּאֶ֖רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃

passages.text: So the field and its cave were deeded by the Hittites to Abraham as a burial site.
passages.sermon:
The Hittites gave Abraham a field.
The field included a cave.
The Hittites gave the field and the cave to Abraham.
Abraham received the field and the cave as a burial site.
passages.original: וַיָּ֨קָם הַשָּׂדֶ֜ה וְהַמְּעָרָ֧ה אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֛וֹ לְאַבְרָהָ֖ם לַאֲחֻזַּת־ קָ֑בֶר מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵי־ חֵֽת׃ס
